title: Curious Cartographer Cuttlefish
statement: This gentle, lamp-eyed cuttlefish spends its days visiting every pebble, sea-glass shard and swaying kelp frond in its amber-lit tank, slowly rippling a living map of everything it has discovered across its own skin. It tilts its head toward each new visitor at the glass, and if you watch long enough, you may find a tiny, shimmering version of yourself sketched in among the stones.
